portfolio.title: Theme switching
portfolio.summary: How a theme choice reaches the browser and changes the board’s appearance.

stops.title: Change the board’s appearance
stops.summary: Coordinates loading the chosen theme and restyling the board, its connections and open documents. It keeps the existing destinations and falls back to Original if the theme cannot load.

stops.title: Fetch a complete theme
stops.summary: Reuses a cached theme when possible. Otherwise it requests the theme’s JSON, checks that the pack is complete, and keeps it for later switches.

stops.title: Serve the validated pack
stops.summary: On the server, this route looks up an enabled theme in the validated registry and returns its data. Unknown or disabled themes receive a 404 response.

scribblescan.title: The saved demo
scribblescan.summary: Follow selected example pages to their saved results. This demo replays earlier processing.

stops.title: Send the selected examples
stops.summary: Collects the chosen demo pages, assigns a task ID, and sends the selection to /demo/digitize. It checks that the server accepted the request.

stops.title: Start a background demo task
stops.summary: Checks the selected file names, schedules the demo service in the background, and returns the task ID so the browser can follow progress.

stops.title: Replay the saved results
stops.summary: Loads saved HTML results and timing records for the example pages. It updates progress using those records; this preserved demo does not run fresh OCR.

flowcode.title: Building the map
flowcode.summary: How source code becomes a saved landscape of related functions and central ideas.

stops.title: Read and vectorize the source
stops.summary: Indexes the selected source, computes or reuses local code embeddings, and builds the terrain views for export. The website later loads the finished snapshot.

stops.title: Position the ideas
stops.summary: Uses vector similarity to place related functions nearby and estimates relevance to the project’s stated purpose. It scales that estimate into height while retaining the underlying scores.

stops.title: Compare neighboring functions
stops.summary: Averages similarity to the ten closest functions, or fewer in small projects. This supplies the novelty part of the score; relevance to the project’s purpose remains the main signal.
